Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride

Roswell, GA · Road

No-drop

Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Roswell, GA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Roswell United Methodist Church parking lot. About 20–25 miles, a 18+ mph, B 16–17 mph, C 14–15 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride group ride

Volunteer-run community ride in Roswell. Twenty to twenty-five miles in pace groups; leaders stay with anyone who falls off. Waiver required. Check the Facebook group to confirm the ride is on.
